card.title: Give It Up
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

mechanism: A presses for the prized signed guitar by pricing the sacrifice and separating its memory from physical ownership.
confusable: Unlike asking for money generally, A must keep targeting the valued object despite an offered lesser substitute.
comparison: D12-b permits keeping the case but not the guitar; D12-a preserves winner recognition while seeking the medal itself.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
